description: This source file is a shell script primarily designed to test the functionality of 'git rev-list --bisect'. It sets up various repository states with commits and tags, then runs multiple tests to validate the correctness of the bisecting process within Git. The script includes functions to perform bisection diffs, runs test sequences with different bisect options, and verifies behavior with fake refs and various flags.

methods.name: test_bisection_diff
methods.description: Performs a bisection diff by comparing the size of the full iteration against the bisected revision list, ensuring the difference is within a specified threshold, used to validate bisect accuracy.

methods.name: test_sequence
methods.description: Runs a series of bisect-related tests on a predefined commit graph, simulating various bisect scenarios, including error cases and bug illustration examples.
